era_description: The taxonomy the Namer authored while a specimen was a fragment of text emitted once and measured. Shifts 0-95. Closed at shift 96 by steward decision, not by the Namer. Preserved unedited.
container_note: The object under 'native' is authored entirely by this terrain's Namer. It is not issued a template, a structure, or a vocabulary. Its only obligation is that for any two specimens it can state whether they are more or less alike, and why (DNT-CLS-001 Section 1).

root.description: Self-contained formal systems expressed in symbolic notation; describe processes, states, and constraints rather than depicting narrative scenes. Includes nested structures, lambda calculus, functional decomposition, explicit constraint declaration, and state machine declaration. Meta-level, structural substrate. Substrates may vary (symbolic trees, lambda notation, XML-like declaration, register/memory notation) but all function as formal specification.

Prose fragments depicting moments or scenes; characterized by filtered light imagery, threshold spaces, and psychological or kinetic suspense. Centered on human or anthropomorphic agents in moments of transition, recognition, or decision.

subcategories.description: Scenes centered on enacted action or movement through space; external event-driven; melancholic or reflective tone. Character traverses literal or figurative boundary; action is primary. Characterized by kinetic energy and forward motion.

Scenes centered on a character's internal deliberation, hesitation, or suspended awareness at a decision point or moment of recognition; action suspended or implicit; characterized by filtered light and threshold imagery; psychological interiority is primary. Subject engages in reflective search or recognition.

anomalies.reason: Hybrid form exhibiting both interior moment and threshold characteristics; poised at narrative precipice rather than settled in either suspended deliberation or enacted action

Phenomenological sensory-threshold: captures an atmospheric moment of suspended sensation ('quiet weight of possibility') anterior to both interior deliberation and threshold action; lacks the psychological decision-work of interior_moment and the enacted movement of threshold

Meta-instructional statement about expected input types; neither structural notation system nor narrative scene. Reads as interface declaration or capacity statement rather than specimen of either substrate. Incommensurable with both established families.
